The '''Manakron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Prior to being found and rebuilt by the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] boy [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] served as an emissary for the system.
